title: 第9章 武馆学徒第10章 观察田大小姐
content_zh:
陈国非常大，十八州，一百多个郡县，而景松县正是在凤鸣州，同安郡治下的一个小县城。
易长生听到客人谈论最多的就是同安郡的郡城，还有凤鸣州的州城。
从那些客人的谈论中得知，凤鸣城不止一个仙人，那里似乎有好几个家族都有人成为仙人。
不过，酒楼里的客人大多都是一知半解，只知道凤鸣城卫云泉和几个大概有仙人的家族，更多的消息他们可能也不知道了。
虽然还没能探到更多准确的消息，但知道哪里有仙人，这一点对易长生来说非常重要。
只要知道哪里有仙人，他就可以通过虚维之眼探查到更多仙人的事情。
有了目标就好，去凤鸣城，探仙人的事情，找机会寻找功法修仙。
不过，不是马上就去，易长生现在的身体太差了，起码要等养好身体才能去。
而且，他年龄还是太小了，出行也不太方便，再加上这个世界的武者众多，城外面的劫匪不少，没点实力他根本就不敢离开。
易长生打算养好身体，学点武功再去也不迟。
这几天从那些客人的口中，他也得知县城里就有三家武馆，其中田家，洪家和周家都有开武馆，口碑最好的是田家与周家的武馆。
当然，在听到那些人说田家武馆不错的时候，易长生就知道他们口中的信息不可靠。
想找到口碑真的好的武馆，还是要他用虚维之眼去看过了后再考虑也不迟。
想着，他看了一眼地下室里剩下的食物，面粉和米还有鸡蛋都还有，但肉和菜都没有了，他现在的身体还是非常需要肉蛋奶补充足够的营养才行。
奶他一时半会找不到，但蛋肉和蔬菜还是很容易买得到的，也是时候再出去补充一些物资了。
易长生看了一眼虚维之眼，虚维之眼经过五天的收集，终于快要收集到一点维点了。
进入虚维之眼视角时，可以看到虚维之眼的权杖处那条小小的进度条，如今已经快到了尽头了。
他直盯着进度条，直到权杖上亮起一个小小的星光。
顿时易长生就知道已经收集到一点维点了。
他看了一眼在座的客人，这些客人都没有什么精神疲惫气血丢失的症状，他们的精神状态还是非常好。

易长生之前就猜到了，虚维之眼并不是吸收智慧生物身体里的精气神。
而是收集智慧生物散发出来的精气神，那些精气神可以说是无主的，哪怕虚维之眼收集再多，对于智慧生物来说也不会有一丁点影响。
看到这个结果，易长生心里松了一口气，他心中默念收回虚维之眼，瞬间淡蓝色的面板背景上就多了一个虚维之眼。
而面板上的信息也变了。
【姓名：易长生】
【寿元：1066】
【天赋：虚维之眼】
【悟性：2】
【灵根：金9水10木23火19土11空28】
【修为：无】
【功法：无】
【技艺：厨艺（入门22100+）】
【维点：1】
其他的都没变，只有维点多了一点。
content_en:
The Chen State was very large, with eighteen states and more than a hundred counties, and Jingsong County was a small county under the jurisdiction of Tong'an County in Fengming Prefecture.
Yi Changsheng heard the guests talking about the county seat of Tong'an County and the state city of Fengming Prefecture the most.
From the conversations of those guests, we learned that there was more than one immortal in Fengming City, and there seemed to be several families there who had people become immortals.
However, most of the guests in the restaurant knew little about it. They only knew Yunquan, the guard of Fengming City, and a few families who probably had immortals. They might not know any more information.
Although no more accurate information has been found, knowing where the immortals are is very important to Yi Changsheng.
As long as he knows where the immortals are, he can detect more things about the immortals through the eyes of virtual dimension.
Just have a goal, go to Fengming City, explore things about immortals, and find opportunities to find techniques to cultivate immortality.
However, he doesn't want to go right away. Yi Changsheng's current health is too bad, and he must at least wait until he recovers before going.
Moreover, he is still too young and it is not convenient to travel. In addition, there are many warriors in this world and there are many robbers outside the city. He does not dare to leave without some strength.
Yi Changsheng planned to take good care of his health and it would not be too late to learn some martial arts.
In the past few days, he also learned from the guests that there were three martial arts gyms in the county. Among them, the Tian family, the Hong family and the Zhou family all had martial arts gyms. The Tian family and the Zhou family had the best reputation.
Of course, when he heard those people say that Tian's martial arts gym was good, Yi Changsheng knew that the information they said was unreliable.
If he wanted to find a martial arts school with a really good reputation, he would have to use his virtual eyes to see it before considering it.
Thinking about it, he took a look at the food left in the basement. There were still flour, rice, and eggs, but the meat and vegetables were gone. His body still needed meat, eggs, and milk to supplement enough nutrition.
He won't be able to find milk for a while, but eggs, meat and vegetables are still easily available, and it's time to go out and replenish some supplies.
Yi Changsheng glanced at the Eye of Xuwei. After five days of collecting the Eye of Xuwei, he was finally close to collecting a few dimensional points.
When entering the perspective of the Eye of Virtual Reality, you can see that the small progress bar at the scepter of the Eye of Virtual Reality is now almost at the end.
He stared at the progress bar until a small star lit up on the scepter.
Immediately Yi Changsheng knew that he had collected some dimension points.
He glanced at the guests present. None of these guests had any symptoms of mental exhaustion or loss of energy and blood. Their mental state was still very good.
Yi Changsheng had guessed before that the Eye of Xuwei did not absorb the energy and spirit from the bodies of intelligent creatures.
Instead, it collects the essences emitted by intelligent creatures. Those essences can be said to be ownerless. No matter how much the Eye of Virtual Dimension collects, it will not have the slightest impact on intelligent creatures.
Seeing this result, Yi Changsheng breathed a sigh of relief. He silently thought in his heart to take back the Eye of Xuwei, and instantly there was an Eye of Xuwei on the background of the light blue panel.
The information on the panel has also changed.
[Name: Yi Changsheng]
【Shouyuan: 1066】
[Talent: Eye of Virtual Dimension]
[Comprehension: 2]
[Spiritual Root: Metal 9 Water 10 Wood 23 Fire 19 Earth 11 Space 28]
[Cultivation: None]
[Skill: None]
[Skill: Cooking (entry level 22100+)]
[Dimension point: 1]
Nothing else has changed, only the dimension points have increased a bit.
